interaction_phrase: Fujitsu and RIKEN announced the installation of a 64-qubit superconducting quantum computer
occurrence_sentence: Recently, [Fujitsu and RIKEN announced the installation of a 64-qubit superconducting quantum computer](https://thequantuminsider.com/2023/10/10/japan-announces-installation-of-second-quantum-computer/), which will be integrated with [a 40-qubit quantum computer simulator](https://www.fujitsu.com/global/about/research/technology/quantum/#:~:text=Fujitsu%20has%20developed%20a%20hybrid,a%2040%2Dqubit%20quantum%20simulator.).
